consequence.statement: Code that imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime in go.mod must update the module path and all import statements to include the v2 suffix when moving to v2+.
consequence.remediation: Update go.mod and all import statements to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 and github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2.

assertion.statement: The Go module path of crossplane is renamed to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 (and crossplane-runtime to .../v2); Go code importing them must update go.mod and import statements.
